evidence: Hashes: frozen environment/Dockerfile 0a75419e..., seed_data.json a1c65c80..., hireops_rules.md 23ba10bf..., integration.md 4eddd8a3..., instruction.md 58b592ff... all match manifest.json inputs.task. (1) Agent image: task/environment/Dockerfile is byte-identical to the frozen template Dockerfile (diff empty). Its only content steps are `COPY instructions/ /instructions/` and `COPY assets/ /assets/`; /app is created, git-initialised, and holds only `.gitkeep` (`touch /app/.gitkeep ... git commit -m "Initialize task workspace"`). The build context is environment/, so solution/ and tests/ cannot be copied in, and neither is referenced. task.toml has no [environment].docker_image, so no prebuilt image with an app is substituted. (2) Assets: environment/contains only Dockerfile, assets/seed_data.json and instructions/{hireops_rules.md,integration.md}. seed_data.json has only input data. Its keys are generated_note, stages, candidate_status_labels, thread_page_size, users(10), jobs(3), applications(16), messages(127), notes(3) and reads(6). It has no expected outputs, schema DDL, routes, UI or answers. A grep for expect/answer/criteri/rubric/judge/grader/score/golden/solution/placeholder found only ordinary prose: a seeded note body ('Strong systems answers...') and 'we answer 401'. It is byte-identical to solution/app/src/seed_data.json, which is the expected input copy, not a deliverable. (3) /instructions: hireops_rules.md:3-5 explicitly leaves 'Routes, field names, element ids, button labels and the shape of the pages' to the builder. It gives behavioural rules and status codes (401/403/404/409) but no route list, schema, skeleton or partial UI. integration.md matches the template integration note plus a deployment paragraph. The only route it names is the template-mandated GET /api/health. (4) No criterion text is reproduced. Word n-gram comparison against all 27 criteria in tests/*/*/judge.toml found 0 shared 8-grams in instruction.md, hireops_rules.md and integration.md. The longest shared run is 7 words ('its most recent 30 messages oldest of'), and it restates a public requirement (rules.md:151). None of the 27 criterion ids or names (hro_*) appear, and there are no grader terms (app_context, restart_app, playwright, weight, dimension, gate, tests/, {criteria}). Weak-app probe: an agent cannot copy a finished app or rubric from /app, /assets or /instructions because none exists. It must build the product from the brief and data. Conforming-alternative probe: nothing in the environment constrains layout or routes, so an alternative implementation is not disadvantaged by leaked structure. Colderwater lessons checked: none of lessons 1-21 introduces an environment-leak pattern. The notes do restate requirements (lesson 12 concerns row 1 tone, not leakage), but they do not copy criterion text, as measured above. The 'check it yourself' line (instruction.md:13, lesson 5) is a user request, not a leak. Evidence type: static source and byte inspection of the frozen inputs. I did not build the agent image. The image contents follow deterministically from the template-identical Dockerfile, and this row needs no runtime measurement.
